python.overview: From beginner foundations and problem solving to asynchronous engine design.

beginner.tier_summary: Core syntax, variables, basic logic, and clean code fundamentals.

modules.title: Magic Boxes
key_takeaways: Variables are named boxes holding numbers, strings, and booleans
Strings wear quotes: name = 'Aditi'
f-strings make clean string interpolation: f'Hello {name}'
modules.practice_challenge: Create a personalized introduction card in the terminal.

modules.title: Traffic Lights
key_takeaways: if evaluates whether an expression is True or False
Indentation in Python defines the code blocks
Comparison operators: ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=
modules.practice_challenge: Build an automated ticket pricing calculator based on age.

modules.title: The Rollercoaster
key_takeaways: for loops iterate over sequences like lists and ranges
range(1, 6) counts from 1 up to 5
while loops repeat as long as a condition holds True
modules.practice_challenge: Create a number guessing game where the computer gives hints.

intermediate.tier_summary: Object-Oriented Design, functional programming, modular design, and file handling.

modules.title: Object Blueprints
key_takeaways: Classes are templates; objects are instances created from them
__init__ sets up initial object state; __repr__ provides debug views
Encapsulation keeps internal object state safe and clean
modules.practice_challenge: Design an RPG game character class with inventory management.

modules.title: Code Wrapping
key_takeaways: Functions are first-class citizens in Python
Decorators wrap and modify function behavior cleanly (@timer)
Generators use yield for memory-efficient lazy evaluation
modules.practice_challenge: Build an execution timer decorator and a custom Fibonacci generator.

expert.tier_summary: Asyncio concurrency, metaprogramming, memory optimization, and C-extensions.

modules.title: Async Engines
key_takeaways: async/await syntax for high-performance concurrent I/O
Understanding asyncio event loops vs threads vs processes
Handling task cancellation and timeouts gracefully
modules.practice_challenge: Build an asynchronous web crawler fetching 30 pages concurrently.

modules.title: Behind the Curtain
key_takeaways: type is the default metaclass that creates classes
Descriptors power properties, methods, and ORMs
Inspecting Python bytecode using the dis module
modules.practice_challenge: Author a custom validation ORM field using the descriptor protocol.

docker.overview: Package, ship, and run any application reliably and portably anywhere.

beginner.tier_summary: Images, containers, Dockerfile creation, port mapping, and volume basics.

modules.title: The Shipping Container
key_takeaways: An image is a frozen blueprint; a container is the running box
docker run -p 8080:80 maps host ports into the container
docker ps, docker stop, docker rm for lifecycle management
modules.practice_challenge: Run a local Nginx web server inside a Docker container.

modules.title: Baking Your Image
key_takeaways: FROM chooses base image; COPY moves files into container
RUN executes during image build; CMD executes on container launch
Layer caching speeds up repeated builds
modules.practice_challenge: Containerize a simple Python Flask hello-world application.

intermediate.tier_summary: Multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, custom bridge networks, and volume persistence.

modules.title: Image Dieting
key_takeaways: Separate build tools from runtime environment
Drastically reduce final image size and security attack surface
modules.practice_challenge: Package a Go or Python application under 50MB using multi-stage builds.

modules.title: The Orchestra Starter
key_takeaways: docker-compose.yml defines multi-service applications
Automatic DNS resolution between containers on the same network
Managing persistent volumes for databases
modules.practice_challenge: Spin up a Flask web app connected to a PostgreSQL database via Compose.

expert.tier_summary: Rootless containers, AppArmor/seccomp profiles, storage drivers, and OCI specs.

modules.title: Fort Knox Containers
key_takeaways: Never run container processes as root (USER nonroot)
Drop unnecessary Linux capabilities: --cap-drop=ALL
Enforcing read-only root filesystems
modules.practice_challenge: Audit and lock down a container with custom seccomp and security profiles.

kubernetes.overview: Automated deployment, scaling, and self-healing management of containerized apps.

beginner.tier_summary: Pods, Deployments, Services, Namespaces, and basic kubectl commands.

modules.title: The Captain's Deck
key_takeaways: Pod is the smallest deployable computing unit in Kubernetes
Control plane vs Worker nodes architecture
Basic commands: kubectl get pods, kubectl describe, kubectl logs
modules.practice_challenge: Launch a single-pod web application on a local Minikube cluster.

modules.title: The Self-Healing Army
key_takeaways: Deployments maintain desired state and handle rolling updates
ReplicaSets automatically replace dead pods
Services provide stable networking and load balancing
modules.practice_challenge: Deploy 3 replicas of an app and demonstrate self-healing by deleting a pod.

intermediate.tier_summary: ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress Controllers, HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaling), and StorageClasses.

modules.title: Traffic Director
key_takeaways: Ingress routes external HTTP/HTTPS traffic to internal services
Host-based and path-based routing rules
modules.practice_challenge: Configure an Nginx Ingress controller to route two domains to different services.

modules.title: Autoscaling Elasticity
key_takeaways: Resource requests vs limits (CPU and memory)
HPA scales replica counts based on observed CPU/memory pressure
modules.practice_challenge: Trigger a synthetic load test and watch pods scale up automatically.

expert.tier_summary: Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), Operators, eBPF Cilium networking, and service mesh.

modules.title: Building Custom Robots
key_takeaways: Extending the Kubernetes API with custom YAML resources
Writing control loops in Go/Python with the reconciliation pattern
modules.practice_challenge: Build a custom Operator that provisions S3 buckets on demand.

java.overview: Strongly typed object-oriented programming, JVM internals, and Spring Boot microservices.

beginner.tier_summary: Syntax, OOP concepts, primitives vs reference types, methods, and collections.

modules.title: Java Building Blocks
key_takeaways: Java is strongly typed: every variable must declare its type
public static void main(String[] args) is the program entry point
Primitive types (int, boolean, double) vs Reference objects (String, List)
modules.practice_challenge: Write a banking simulation program with Account objects.

modules.title: The Collection Basket
key_takeaways: List keeps ordered items; Set ensures uniqueness
Map stores key-value pairs with fast lookups
Enhanced for-each loop syntax: for (String item : items)
modules.practice_challenge: Build a student grade management system using HashMaps.

intermediate.tier_summary: Streams API, Lambdas, Generics, Exception hierarchies, and JDBC/Spring basics.

modules.title: Flowing Streams
key_takeaways: Streams process data declarations with filter, map, and collect
Lambdas provide concise inline function implementations
modules.practice_challenge: Process a list of 1,000 transactions to find top customers using Streams.

expert.tier_summary: JVM memory model, Garbage Collection tuning, Virtual Threads (Project Loom), and classloaders.

modules.title: Loom & Millions of Threads
key_takeaways: Virtual threads are lightweight JVM threads decoupled from OS threads
High-throughput concurrent servers without reactive programming complexity
modules.practice_challenge: Benchmark 50,000 concurrent network tasks using Virtual Threads.

rust.overview: Fearless concurrency, zero-cost abstractions, and guaranteed memory safety without a garbage collector.

beginner.tier_summary: Immutability by default, Ownership, Borrowing, References, and Pattern Matching.

modules.title: The Borrowing Rulebook
key_takeaways: Each value in Rust has an owner; only one owner at a time
When owner goes out of scope, value is dropped immediately
Borrowing: you can have multiple &T (immutable) OR one &mut T (mutable), but never both
modules.practice_challenge: Write functions demonstrating ownership passing vs borrowing references.

modules.title: The Swiss Army Knife
key_takeaways: Rust has no null: Option<T> handles presence or absence safely
Result<T, E> and the ? operator for robust error propagation
Pattern matching with match forces exhaustive case handling
modules.practice_challenge: Build a command-line calculator that parses expressions with safe error returns.

intermediate.tier_summary: Traits, Generics, Lifetimes, Smart Pointers (Box, Rc, Arc, RefCell), and Cargo crates.

modules.title: Sharing Across Walls
key_takeaways: Arc<Mutex<T>> enables safe shared state across multiple threads
Lifetimes ('a) ensure references never outlive the data they point to
modules.practice_challenge: Build a multi-threaded work queue where workers safely update shared stats.

expert.tier_summary: Unsafe Rust, FFI bindings, zero-cost abstractions, SIMD, and custom memory allocators.

modules.title: Stepping Outside the Sandbox
key_takeaways: unsafe keyword allows dereferencing raw pointers and calling C functions
Encapsulating unsafe blocks inside rock-solid safe API wrappers
modules.practice_challenge: Write a high-performance circular ring buffer using raw pointers wrapped in safe Rust.

cpp.overview: High-performance systems programming from pointers and RAII to Modern C++20/23 concepts.

beginner.tier_summary: Pointers, references, memory stack vs heap, structs, classes, and RAII basics.

modules.title: Memory Addresses & Pointers
key_takeaways: A pointer stores memory addresses (&x); dereference with *p
References (&ref) are aliases that cannot be reseated or null
Stack memory is automatic; Heap memory requires lifetime management
modules.practice_challenge: Implement a swap function using pointers and then using references.

modules.title: Never Forget to Clean Up
modules.concept: RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) & Smart Pointers
key_takeaways: Destructors run automatically when objects leave scope
std::unique_ptr for single ownership; std::shared_ptr for reference counting
Avoid raw new and delete in modern C++
modules.practice_challenge: Manage a dynamic buffer using std::unique_ptr without memory leaks.

intermediate.tier_summary: Templates, Move Semantics (rvalue references), STL Algorithms, and Lambda expressions.

modules.title: Moving Instead of Copying
key_takeaways: lvalues (named identifiers) vs rvalues (temporary values)
Move constructors steal resources instead of making deep copies
modules.practice_challenge: Implement a custom dynamic Array class with Rule of 5 move semantics.

expert.tier_summary: Template metaprogramming, C++20 Concepts, Coroutines, lock-free data structures.

modules.title: Compile-Time Computation
key_takeaways: Concepts constrain template types with clear compiler errors
Running complex algorithms completely at compile time with constexpr
modules.practice_challenge: Write a compile-time dimensional analysis unit system using Concepts.

machine_learning.overview: From linear models and gradient descent to deep neural networks and transformer architectures.

beginner.tier_summary: Data pipelines with Pandas/Numpy, Supervised vs Unsupervised learning, and evaluation metrics.

modules.title: Finding the Best Fit Line
key_takeaways: Features (X) predict targets (y) using y = mx + b
Mean Squared Error (MSE) measures how far off our predictions are
Train/Test split prevents memorizing data (overfitting)
modules.practice_challenge: Train a model in Scikit-Learn to predict house prices from features.

modules.title: Yes or No Decisions
key_takeaways: Sigmoid function converts outputs into 0-to-1 probabilities
Accuracy vs Precision vs Recall vs F1-score
Confusion matrix reveals false positives and false negatives
modules.practice_challenge: Build a spam message classifier and evaluate its Precision and Recall.

intermediate.tier_summary: Tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, XGBoost), hyperparameter tuning, and baseline Neural Networks.

modules.title: Forest of Experts
modules.concept: Decision Trees, Random Forests & Gradient Boosting
key_takeaways: Bagging combines multiple independent trees to reduce variance
Boosting trains trees sequentially to fix previous errors (XGBoost/LightGBM)
Feature importance scores highlight critical data columns
modules.practice_challenge: Predict customer churn with XGBoost and interpret feature importance.

expert.tier_summary: Deep Learning (PyTorch), Backpropagation mathematics, Convolutional Networks, and Attention/Transformers.

modules.title: Attention is All You Need
key_takeaways: Queries, Keys, and Values compute context-aware token vectors
Positional encodings provide order awareness without recurrence
How modern LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini) generate tokens autoregressively
modules.practice_challenge: Implement multi-head self-attention from scratch in PyTorch.

golang.overview: High-concurrency cloud services, microservices, and fast compiled systems programming.

beginner.tier_summary: Syntax, packages, structs, slices, maps, and explicit error handling.

modules.title: Gopher Foundations
key_takeaways: Go code lives in packages; main() is the entry point
Slices are dynamic views into arrays
Explicit error handling: if err != nil is standard idiom
modules.practice_challenge: Write a CLI tool that reads a file and counts word frequencies using maps.

modules.title: The Gopher Postal Service
key_takeaways: go keyword launches ultra-lightweight goroutines (few KB memory)
Channels send and receive data safely between goroutines
Do not communicate by sharing memory; share memory by communicating
modules.practice_challenge: Build a concurrent URL status checker checking 10 websites simultaneously.

intermediate.tier_summary: Interfaces (implicit implementation), buffered channels, select statement, and context timeouts.

modules.title: Implicit Blueprints
key_takeaways: Types implement interfaces implicitly (duck typing with static safety)
Embedding structs for composition instead of class hierarchies
modules.practice_challenge: Build a pluggable payment processor supporting PayPal and Stripe interfaces.

modules.title: Channel Orchestration
key_takeaways: select waits on multiple channel operations simultaneously
context.Context passes deadlines, cancellation signals, and request values
modules.practice_challenge: Build a worker pool that handles task cancellation gracefully on timeout.

expert.tier_summary: Go runtime scheduler (GMP model), sync/atomic primitives, pprof memory profiling, and unsafe pointers.

modules.title: Under the Gopher Hood
modules.concept: GMP Scheduler, Garbage Collection Tuning & pprof
key_takeaways: GMP model: Goroutines, OS threads (M), and logical processors (P)
Profiling CPU and heap allocations using go tool pprof
Lock-free concurrency with sync/atomic
modules.practice_challenge: Profile a high-throughput microservice and eliminate memory heap escapes.
